note: The walker (doc 23, presence below; approved October 21, 2026). You, on foot: tap a spot and the figure walks there along the walk grid. grid: cells of cellM meters over the open land; a cell is walkable if its slope is under maxSlopeDeg; a step between neighbours may climb at most maxStepM (a cliff face is more); water over a cell right now must be shallower than wadeM (knee deep). wadeCost makes wading slower to choose than dry ground. snapM: a tap on a spot you can't stand on walks to the nearest one within this reach. pace: one calm stroll that eases to a creep within creepNearM of a creature, a double tap within doubleTapMs hurries (brisk); in water deeper than wadeAnkleM the walk slows to wadeMps, hurrying or not (October 21, 2026: slower paces for the short-legged figure; October 22, Matt: stroll 1.5 and brisk 2.7, both faster); accelMps2 eases speed changes, turnDegPerS how fast the figure turns. camera: the low view behind you, distanceM its zoom range, startM where a glide down lands, pitchDeg the look up and down range (negative looks up), startPitchDeg the glide's pitch, lookHeightM where it aims on you, minEyeHeightM how low the eye may come over ground or water; orbitDegPerPx, how far a drag turns the view below (degrees a pixel; October 23, 2026, F16: well under half the view from above), and turnHalfLifeS, how softly the turn eases in (October 21, 2026: all four brought in by 0.737 with the figure, now drawn 1.4 m tall, not 1.9 m, so creatures read larger beside you). The figure itself is recipes/world/figure.json. tide: retreat to dry ground when the water ahead passes wadeM. words: the lines the island says.

presence.note: You on foot as creatures feel you (W3): heightM is how far your body is over your feet in each posture (where the ring is measured from, and where the view aims). Set for the 1.4 m figure (October 21, 2026: 0.737 of the 1.9 m numbers). Posture and gaze stretch or shrink each species' comfort ring by its presence.multipliers.

ground.note: The ground bar (W4): Feed kneels and puts food down feedAheadM in front of you. Net is picked into your hand like a seed and set where you click (D1a; recipes/world/sowing.json net).

click.note: One click walks and uses (Matt, October 22, 2026; Look retired). A thing (a plant, a find, a keepsake, a log or stone, a net, a pile) walks you to within thingReachM beyond its own ring and opens its card on arrival. A creature's card opens where you stand within creatureCardM (you never walk up to it, so a click never startles); further off you walk until that close. Ground that is everywhere (grass, sand, pebbles, the strandline) opens a card only when something lies there to gather: within nearLookM of you at once, further off after walking up to it like a thing. Plain ground never opens a card; a click just walks there. hoverHz: how often the pointer is read for the hand cursor. The name tag (F4, October 23, 2026) shows only once the pointer rests on a thing hoverRestS seconds (moving less than hoverRestPx), fades in over hoverFadeS, and sits over the thing, never following the pointer; moving onto another thing hides it until a new rest.
